americas-measles-elimination-2016.summary: On 27 September 2016 Pan American Health Organization's International Expert Committee declared Americas free of endemic measles transmission, after no endemic case since 2002 across 35 countries; it followed rubella elimination in 2015. The result rested on a 1990s strategy of catch-up, keep-up and follow-up campaigns with measles-mumps-rubella vaccine, coordinated by PAHO's Revolving Fund and national programmes from Mexico to Chile, and on laboratory surveillance networks. Status proved fragile: Venezuela lost it in 2018 and Brazil in 2019 as outbreaks spread from imported cases, the region regained verification in November 2024, and on 10 November 2025 Canada's twelve-month outbreak cost Americas regional status once more.

belo-monte-dam-2016.summary: On 5 May 2016 President Dilma Rousseff inaugurated Belo Monte near Altamira, Pará, weeks after its first 611-megawatt turbine began commercial operation on 20 April; full installed capacity of about 11,233 megawatts, reached in 2019, placed it among four largest hydroelectric plants worldwide. Its run-of-river design uses a canal to divert most of Xingu river around Volta Grande, a 100-kilometre bend home to Juruna and Arara communities, flooding roughly 440 to 500 square kilometres and reducing flow around Volta Grande, with output averaging well below capacity in dry seasons. Planned from 1975 as Kararaô and stopped by 1989 protests, the project was revived under Lula and built by consortium Norte Energia for about 40 billion reais. It remains Brazil's most contested energy project.

burkina-bt-cotton-reversal-2016.summary: Burkina Faso, Africa's largest cotton producer, introduced Monsanto's insect-resistant Bt cotton in 2008 and by 2014 it covered nearly three quarters of planted area, cutting pesticide spraying. Yet INERA tests had shown Bt fibres running shorter than conventional varieties, and ginners found lint quality falling below premium grades Burkinabe cotton had commanded. In 2015 and 2016 cotton companies, led by Sofitex, cut Bt planting to zero and sought compensation of about 48 billion CFA francs, settling with Monsanto in 2017. Burkina Faso had been held up as a showcase for GM crops among smallholders, and its reversal reshaped debate on biotechnology across Africa.

compas-propublica-2016.summary: In 2016 ProPublica showed a sentencing algorithm wrongly flagged Black defendants as future criminals at nearly twice the rate of whites, 44.9 against 23.5 percent. Its analysis focused on classification errors, or how often the algorithm wrongly predicted whether a defendant would reoffend; Northpointe disputed its analysis, and a separate 2010 Florida State University study had found its scores predicted recidivism equally accurately regardless of race. That dispute over which fairness measure counts inspired a wave of empirical research on algorithmic risk tools.

delhi-odd-even-2016.summary: From 1 to 15 January 2016 Delhi's government allows private cars on roads only on alternate days by last digit of their number plates, with exemptions for women drivers, two-wheelers and CNG vehicles, enforced by police and volunteers. Winter smog had pushed fine particulate levels far above limits. Economists Greenstone, Harish, Pande and Sudarshan compare 23 Delhi monitors against Faridabad, Gurgaon and Noida and estimate a 10 to 13 percent relative fall in particulates, about 18 percent during 8 am to 8 pm hours. A repeat in April 2016 shows little effect and later rounds in 2017 and 2019 are contested. Odd-even becomes a recurring emergency measure while studies point to crop burning and road dust as larger sources.

great-barrier-reef-bleaching-2016.summary: In March and April 2016, sea temperatures up to 1.5 degrees above normal, driven by global warming and an El Nino, bleached 91 percent of 1,156 surveyed reefs along Great Barrier Reef. Aerial and underwater surveys led by Terry Hughes found northern third, previously least disturbed, lost around two-thirds of shallow corals within nine months, mostly rapidly growing branching and tabular species. Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority's final report recorded 29 percent coral loss reef-wide. A second bleaching in 2017 hit central section, so that 1,500 kilometres of reef bleached in consecutive years, with no time to recover. Hughes argued local water-quality and fishing controls offered little protection against heat.

india-demonetisation-2016.summary: On 8 November 2016 India voided its 500 and 1,000 rupee notes overnight, and queues formed at banks for weeks. Prime Minister Narendra Modi said this move would curb India's shadow economy, push cashless payment and cut counterfeiting and terrorist financing; old notes were to be exchanged for new 500 and 2,000 rupee notes. People queued for hours, several deaths were linked to the rush, and industrial production and GDP growth fell. Digital payments rose sharply in November and December, but about 99.3 percent of the voided notes were deposited, leading analysts to judge that it failed to remove black money.

iran-national-information-network-2016.summary: On 28 August 2016 Iran's communications ministry inaugurates first phase of National Information Network (Shabake-ye Melli-ye Ettela'at), a project legislated in 2005 and built over a decade: domestic data centres, exchange points, a national DNS and pricing that makes traffic to Iranian hosts cheaper and faster than foreign traffic. Officials present it as sovereignty and resilience; rights groups read it as architecture for cutting Iran off while keeping banks, state media and local apps running. That reading is tested in November 2019, when authorities shut international connectivity for about a week during fuel protests while domestic services stay up, and again in 2022. Network also underpins state-backed messaging apps and search engines meant to displace Telegram and Google.

ulmfit-elmo-2018.summary: In 2018 ELMo gave each word a representation that depended on its sentence; pretraining on text then tuning became the way to do language. It represents each word by numbers drawn from a language model that has read the whole sentence in both directions. Earlier word embeddings gave each word one fixed representation wherever it appeared; ELMo's shift with context, and it improved results across six language tasks, including question answering, judging whether one sentence follows from another, and sentiment analysis.
